sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Vinod Kumar Singh,Rajesh Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.
Supplementary affidavit filed by learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Rajesh Kumar Singh, learned counsel for applicant as well as Sri Anit Kumar Shukla,
learned A.G.A. for State and also perused the material available on record.
3.

The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed for protection in regard to FIR/Case Crime No. 432 of 2023, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 352, 506 I.P.C., P.S.- Bansdih,
District- Ballia.

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, the applicant is stated to have purchased the land from one Chaan Kali and Savita Devi, who had executed the said sale deed without any rights.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Learned counsel has next stated that the said sellers had sold the land to the applicant after the sale deed was executed by the husband of Chaan Kali to her and her daughter Savita Devi.
It is next stated that the applicant is a bonafide purchaser.
He himself has been duped of his hard earned money.
The applicant had no knowledge about the dispute of title among the family members.
The instant FIR has been instituted by the daughter-in-law of the co-accused person Chaan Kali.

Learned counsel has stated that the criminal history of four cases assigned to the applicant has been explained, as in three cases, he has been enlarged on bail, except one case bearing Case Crime No. 391 of 2008, u/s 323, 332, 353, 427, 504, 506 IPC, P.S. Bairiya, District Ballia, as he could not furnish the whereabouts of the said file.
It is stated that the applicant is not the previous convict.
Learned counsel has stated that the applicant had no knowledge of the said case pending against him.
In case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed, he will not misuse the liberty and shall cooperate with trial.

6. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail and has stated that the criminal history of one case has not been explained, as such, the applicant is not entitled for anticipatory bail.

7. Considering the rival submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and also the fact that the applicant has criminal history of four cases, of which, one case has not been explained, I do not find it a fit case for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant as the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant pertain to regular bail application and cannot be agitated at this stage u/s 438 Cr.P.C.
8.

In view of the above, the present anticipatory bail application is found devoid of merits and is,
accordingly, rejected.

9. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of anticipatory bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case.
(Justice Krishan Pahal) Order Date :- 18.12.2023 Shalini  Rajesh Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88582090/
